answer: New identities start with zero weight, and the lantern only illuminates peers whose signed history matches on-chain records. Agents must forge a stake-weighted identity by locking tokens and completing verifiable work each epoch; a quill signs every contribution into a chained ledger of provenance. Sybil attackers must pay the full stake per fake identity and sustain real work costs, so mass forgery becomes economically self-defeating while honest agents compound reputation over time.
